cm-vs-fn-p161-n03.note_text:
The great Rishies once wanted to know who is great among the Trinity. Bhrigu who was deputed for this, and who failed to assess Brahmaa and Siva as the greatest, went to Vaikuntha. Seeing Viṣṇu in His Yoga Nidraa, he deliberately kicked Him on the chest. Waking up suddenly, the Lord regretted that he had been asleep on Bhrigu’s arrival and apologetically began massaging the Sage’s foot, hoping that his holy soft foot which could destroy the sins of the seekers had not been hurt. Since by the touch of the divine foot His sins are destroyed, Bhagavān says, He will ever bear the mark of the sage’s foot as SREE on His chest.

—Sreemad Bhagavatam, 10th Skandhu.
